_comment: Hand corrections to the OCR of 大地巡旅. Applied by scripts/mineru_book.py on every run, so they survive re-imports — never edit the nodes table directly, import_book.py replaces it wholesale. Run scripts/check_book_ocr.py for a ranked list of candidates; its 1-substitution tier is the working list.
_fields: wrong / right are literal strings. Add `pages: [n, …]` to scope a replacement when the wrong form is a real word elsewhere. A rule that matches nothing is reported as stale on the next run.
